steps.content: The defeated mascots reveal their Corruptor appearances for a moment, then transform into colorful foam, melting in the sky and disappearing into the surrounding joy.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So these guys... were all transformed from Corruptors?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Of course this is all an illusion. It's the Sinner Hamel's ability.
This world is real and the Corruptors are real. Invisible contamination and the Black Ring must truly exist too.
But a grander illusion overlays and controls everything, creating a magnificent and colorful delusion.

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: Go back! Go back! This is our parade, you don't belong here!
You've defeated those mascots, but still get pushed to the amusement park's gate by them. The marching crowd has gone back to normal and continues to cheer Hamel's name, marching on.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, I can't believe they've actually rejected us. Should we try again?
Go back, this is not a place you can wander in.
You hear a voice and turn back to see an old man sitting on some well-concealed steps at the park's entrance.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: This park doesn't belong to humans... doesn't belong to you.
